in_hebrew.name: Korrie
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Daughter of Cyrrhus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Korrie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Korrie is the name of a nymph who was the daughter of Cyrrhus, a legendary king. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'koros,' meaning 'maiden' or 'girl.' In Christianity, Korrie can be interpreted as a strong and independent name for a girl, symbolizing the power and grace of the divine feminine.
